title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.basis: Visually checked ventricular landmarks on original PDF 512
fields.reason: Successive ventricular peak spacings: 149 px, 154 px, 149 px, 148 px. Descriptive judgment from visible spacing, not a validated diagnostic threshold.

fields.basis: Course-standard 25 mm/s assumption; 150 independently detected small-square intervals across 738 pixels
fields.reason: Mean R–R estimate 49.2 bpm; six-second count estimate 50 bpm. All seconds/bpm depend on course-standard 25 mm/s. Count estimate assumes 150 small squares = 6 seconds; endpoint phase and partial complexes affect it. On irregular strips the count estimate is not a stable instantaneous rate. Mean RR describes only intervals between observed peaks.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Four complete low positive pre-QRS candidates precede the second through fifth small biphasic ventricular complexes; the first candidate is outside the left edge. The candidates are separated from the broad post-QRS deflections by long baseline intervals. Baseline drift and variable amplitude limit exact onset and identity.

fields.value: Slow, approximately regular ventricular rhythm near 49 bpm with separate P-like lobes before the complete interior cycles. Sinus bradycardia is a teaching possibility only if uniform sinus-compatible P morphology in a known lead and a consistent P-to-QRS relationship are confirmed throughout. The broad conditional intervals do not establish PR constancy or the complete course conduction criteria, and the cropped first context remains excluded.
fields.basis: New independently reviewed educational synthesis of the exact original raster, conditional source measurements and stated course criteria; not a source-authored or educator-validated rhythm answer
fields.reason: Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred. Visible-deflection observations are supplied without validated P-wave identity. PR and QRS have unvalidated conditional estimates. Optional educational comparison only, not a source-authored answer or confirmed rhythm diagnosis. A candidate atrial association is not proof of sinus origin. Timing retains the recorded calibration assumptions and holds. Interval envelopes apply to the selected endpoint-review cycles and describe boundary uncertainty, not actual beat-to-beat variability, normal conduction or a full-strip atrial census. These newly derived observations remain unscored and are not eligible as validated answer keys.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.
Excluded x826 detector proposal: falling strip-edge baseline, not an additional QRS.

P-wave text is a provisional description, not validated atrial identity. PR has an unvalidated conditional endpoint envelope for selected complexes. Calibration assumes the course’s 25 mm/s convention, not speed metadata printed on each strip. Peak uncertainty is approximately ±2 source pixels, excluding errors in identifying the waveform.
